Name: Conveyant Shell
Source: Lyres Guide to Risk and Reward
Information: Made from a combination of red oak wood, glass blades, and crimson iron plating, these constructs are given life by Individa to serve the members of the Red Manor. They are foot soldiers and disposable assassins who can be left behind after a messy assault on a target. Once they aren’t needed or after they’re destroyed, they are reduced to ash and leave no evidence of what might have occurred.

Stat Blocks.title: Conveyant Shell
languages: understands Common and Elvish but doesn’t speak

traits.name: Compact Form
traits.description: The construct can, through a combination of magic and engineering, reduce its body to a form that is not much larger than a suitcase which can be easily transported. It weighs 70 lbs while in this form and is “inert”, functioning as an object and not as a creature until it is damaged or commanded to awaken by a creature with the authority to control it. In this form it can be carried with one hand as if it was a metal case by Medium-sized creatures. A DC 15 Arcana or Investigation can tell it is a compact construct.

traits.name: Critical Vulnerability
traits.description: When the construct suffers a critical hit, it takes double damage from the additional damage dice rolled as part of the critical hit, and it becomes sluggish until it completes a Short or Long Rest.

traits.name: Evidence Erasure
traits.description: When this construct is reduced to 0 hit points, its body dissolves into a chalky ash that cannot be connected back to its original form. This ash resembles ground charcoal.

traits.name: Unkind Attacker
traits.description: When the construct rolls a result of 1 or 2 on any damage die, it rerolls the damage die/dice and must keep the new result.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The construct makes two attacks, choosing between its Blade Chain and Glass Claw for each. The first of these attacks has advantage.

actions.name: Bladed Chain
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage. If two of these attacks hit the same Medium or smaller creature in one turn, the construct may pull that creature into an unoccupied space adjacent to them and make a single Glass Claw attack against them.

actions.name: Glass Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (3d4 + 3) slashing damage.
